answer: Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 6 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in prism and voyage lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the sable graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 442 impostors cost 1605 times the honest price and take 21 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
